name: Wearing Hats
overview: Scripture addresses the topic of wearing hats and garments with clear distinctions rooted in God's design for gender and worship. Deuteronomy 22:5 prohibits men and women from wearing each other's clothing, labeling such actions as an abomination to the Lord. Daniel 3:21 highlights the cultural practice of wearing hats or turbans along with other garments, demonstrating the historical context of attire. While Revelation 1:1 does not directly address clothing, it reminds believers of the divine revelation given to Christ's servants, encouraging faithfulness in all aspects of life, including obedience to God's instructions about appearance.
